title: Walt & Bev
blurb: A new family, not one of the X-ray’s four: Ohio, and Bev is still working.
notes:
New prospect: Walt & Bev Lindqvist (referral from the Hoffmans), 10/31
Live outside Columbus, Ohio. Walt 66, retired from the county in June. Bev 61, still working as a school administrator, makes about $82k, wants to work until 65. She puts about $12k a year in her 403b.
Walt's county pension: $2,450/mo, small COLA. He picked the 100% joint and survivor option - showed me the letter.
Walt claimed SS at 66, $2,350/mo. Bev's statement: $1,900/mo at full retirement age, thinking 67.
Walt's 457 + IRA together about $310k. Bev's 403b $240k. They have a joint brokerage, maybe $60k, no idea on cost basis. Emergency fund $35k.
House ~$295k, still a small mortgage (didn't get the balance).
Spend around $6,000/mo now. Big goal: help their granddaughter with college, $10k/yr for 4 years starting 2031. A trip to Sweden next year, $15k.
Conservative investor - Bev hates watching it drop. Biggest worry for Bev is a crash. Walt cares most that Bev is okay. Could maybe trim a little.
Walt asked when Bev should take Social Security.
